items.name: 六臂

items.name: 法术库
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

items.name: 织维巫师施法
items.expectedDescription:
Your paradox grants you magical power. You can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a witchwarper, when you cast spells, you might describe your revelations about other realities aloud, accompanied by elegant gestures while arcane equations or occult symbols blaze around you.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a witchwarper, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Charisma or Intelligence modifier, depending on which you chose for your key attribute.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank, heightening it to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of witchwarper spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.

Warp Spells

You can create powerful magical phenomena known as warp spells. Warp spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a warp spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to contemplate infinite worlds or conduct quantum magical research.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Warp spells have the anchoring trait, unlike other focus spells. This trait means you can only use warp spells while your quantum field is active, and you automatically Sustain your quantum field when you cast warp spells.

You learn warp spells based on your paradox.

items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. items.name: 织维巫师施法
items.expectedDescription:
Your paradox grants you magical power. You can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a witchwarper, when you cast spells, you might describe your revelations about other realities aloud, accompanied by elegant gestures while arcane equations or occult symbols blaze around you.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a witchwarper, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Charisma or Intelligence modifier, depending on which you chose for your key attribute.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank, heightening it to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of witchwarper spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.

Warp Spells

You can create powerful magical phenomena known as warp spells. Warp spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a warp spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to contemplate infinite worlds or conduct quantum magical research.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Warp spells have the anchoring trait, unlike other focus spells. This trait means you can only use warp spells while your quantum field is active, and you automatically Sustain your quantum field when you cast warp spells.

You learn warp spells based on your paradox.

items.description: 你懂得如何使用强大的武器来阻碍敌人，并遏阻他们以全盛姿态行动。当你进行一次具有区域特征的攻击（例如来自@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]动作），你将以压制目标的方式来运用它。受影响区域内的生物如果没有成功通对你攻击的豁免，便会陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]状态，直到你的下个回合开始。被压制的目标在攻击骰上有-1环境减值，在速度上有-10尺状态减值。有些士兵能力和职业专长会和被压制状态产生进一步交互。

items.name: 主目标
items.expectedDescription: You can focus fire on a single target when unleashing the full devastation of your powerful area weaponry. Before you make an area attack with a weapon (such as from the Area Fire or Auto-Fire actions), you can make a ranged Strike as a free action with the same weapon against a single creature in the area, who's selected as your primary target. If your attack is a burst, you must select the creature closest to the center of the attack. If your attack is a cone or line, you must select the creature closest to you. If two or more creatures are equidistant, you can choose which one is your primary target. On a hit, if your primary target rolls a success against your Area Fire or Auto-Fire action, they get a failure instead. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.
items.description: 当你完全倾泻手中强大武装的毁灭性火力时，你可以对一个目标制造尤为强大的火力。当你进行一次具有区域效果的攻击前（例如区域射击或自动射击动作），你可以以自由动作以相同的武器对区域中单个生物进行一次远程打击，将其作为你的主目标。如果你的攻击是爆发，你必须选择最接近攻击中心的生物。如果你的攻击为锥形或线形，你必须选择最接近你的生物。如果两个或两个以上的生物距离相等或最近，你可以选择其中一个作为你的主目标。如果你使用此次打击成功命中你的主目标，且目标对你的区域射击或自动射击掷骰出成功结果，其改为获得失败结果。此次打击不计入你的多重攻击减值。

items.name: 坚固藤蔓
items.expectedDescription: You've grown a stout vine that you can use to bludgeon enemies. You gain a vine unarmed attack, which is in the brawling weapon group, deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, and has the khizar, sweep, trip, and unarmed traits.
items.description: 你长出了一根粗壮的藤蔓，可以用来钝击敌人。你获得藤蔓无武装攻击，它属于搏击武器组，造成1d6钝击伤害，并具有奇植族，横扫，摔绊与无武装特征。

items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

items.name: 龙人
items.expectedDescription:
Draconic in appearance and fiercely loyal, dragonkin are deeply empathic beings capable of forming a nearly unbreakable spiritual bond with one other creature, which manifests in telepathic communication and tactical synergy.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.EybiktinX2zD2k45]{Dragonkin}
items.description:
龙人外貌与龙类似，相当忠诚，他们具有深刻的共情能力，能与其他生物形成几乎牢不可破的精神纽带，外显为心灵感应和战术协同。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.EybiktinX2zD2k45]{Dragonkin}

items.name: 伴侣纽带
items.expectedDescription: You can form a permanent empathic bond with one willing sapient creature—usually a non-dragonkin. Forming this bond is a one-hour activity that can only be attempted if both you and your partner share a deep emotional bond. You and your partner must remain within reach of each other for the duration of this activity for it to succeed. Once this bond is formed, you can't form another partner bond unless your current partner dies. You and your partner can communicate with each other mentally, as if you had limited telepathy with a range of 60 feet.
items.description: 你可以与一位自愿的智慧生物（通常为非龙类）建立永久的共情纽带。建立此纽带需要一小时，且只有你和你的伴侣之间拥有深厚的情感纽带才能尝试。你和你的伴侣必须在此活动期间保持彼此触手可及的距离才能成功。一旦建立此纽带，除非你当前的伴侣死亡，否则你将无法再建立伴侣纽带。你和你的伴侣可以进行精神交流，如同你们拥有60尺范围的有限心灵感应能力。

items.name: 焰心龙人
items.expectedDescription: The embers burning in your blood keep you safe from the chill of high altitudes. You gain resistance to cold equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
items.description: 你血液中燃烧的余烬使你免受高海拔寒冷的侵袭。你获得相当于你等级一半（最低为1）的寒冷抗力。你受到寒冷气候的影响会降低一级（酷寒变为极寒，极寒变为严寒，以此类推）。

items.name: 运动员
items.expectedDescription:
You've strengthened your body through practice drills and workouts, making sure not to waste a single drop of sweat in your quest for gains. You might be a champion fighting in arena matches, a hardcore gym rat, or a heavy hitter on a competitive sports team—what matters to you is the rush you get when you beat a personal record.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Sports Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.Wc26O3XFKxWfxY5N] skill feat.
items.description:
你通过练习和锻炼强化了自己的身体，确保在追求进步的过程中不浪费一滴汗水。你可能是竞技场冠军选手，或者是一个疯狂健身的健身爱好者，亦或是在竞争激烈的体育团队中表现突出的重击手——对你来说，打破个人记录所带来的快感才是最重要的。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是力量或敏捷，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的运动技能和体育学识（Sports Lore）技能受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.Wc26O3XFKxWfxY5N]（Deadlift）技能专长。

items.name: 硬举
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

For 1 minute, you can carry 4 more Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered. The amount you can carry increases to 6 at expert, 8 at master, and 10 at legendary. When the benefits of this feat end, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 10 minutes.

需求你没有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]状态

在1分钟内，你可以携带比正常多4B的物品而不受超载影响。额外的负载在运动专家时提升至6，大师时提升至8，传奇时提升至10。当此专长带来的好处结束时，你陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]10分钟。

items.name: 恒星武士
items.expectedDescription:
You're a conduit for the stellar forces of the cosmos—a solar knight. The powers of gravity and light represent the extremes of these forces, and you can attune yourself between them. As an agent of this cycle, you manifest an array of solar equipment and use your own connection to stellar forces to empower them. Regardless of which extreme of the stellar spectrum you prefer, you can change your attunement between them to take advantage of solar powers earned through meditation and practice.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.Nb6sw1oNTFwVPlLu]{Solarian}
items.description:
你是引导宇宙星辰之力的隧道——一名星辰骑士。重力与光分别位于这份力量天平的两极，而你可以则可以以身入道，调和其间。作为这一轮二元循环的代行者，你能够显现一系列恒星武装，并利用自身与星辰之力的联系来强化它们。无论你偏爱这星辰光谱的哪一极，你都能自如地改变自身同其二者间的调谐，并通过刻苦的冥想与锻炼来获取独一无二的特殊力量。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.Nb6sw1oNTFwVPlLu]{Solarian}

items.name: 恒星显象
items.expectedDescription:
Your deep understanding of the stellar forces of the universe manifests in a variety of tangible ways. You can create and maintain three different manifestations: a solar flare, solar nimbus, and solar weapon. Your manifestations temporarily vanish if you become unattuned.

Solar Flare

A small mote of solar power hovers nearby or appears embedded on some part of your body, such as the palm of your hand or on your face. This mote can unleash a directed blast of energy at short range. Your solar flare is a martial ranged weapon in the brawling weapon group with the attuned and solarian traits. It doesn't take up a hand and doesn't need to be held to be wielded. Your solar flare can't be targeted by other creatures or removed from your person, except for when you become unattuned. Your attunement determines the damage type and range increment of your solar flare. You add your Strength modifier to damage rolls with your solar flare. You can improve the damage of your solar flare with solarian crystals.

Graviton-Attuned 1d8 bludgeoning, range increment 15 feet. On a critical success, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target as a free action, ignoring range and multiple attack penalty, even if you don't have a free hand.

Photon-Attuned 1d6 fire, range increment 30 feet. On a critical success, the target additionally takes 1d6 persistent fire damage.

Solar Nimbus

A layer of stellar energy surrounds you, overlaying your body or worn armor. It appears as a layer of glowing light or solid darkness, depending on your current state of attunement. The general appearance and shape of the nimbus is your choice and could appear as a lattice of energy surrounding you or imposing spiked energy armor layered atop your existing equipment. This design has no impact on its function and doesn't provide any additional bonuses.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm] reaction.

Solar Weapon

Through sheer will, you call forth a tangible weapon forged from the essence of stars. This weapon is an extension of yourself, and you can change its form with meditation. When manifesting your weapon, it appears in a free hand of your choice. If it has the free-hand trait, it can manifest in any hand. Your solar weapon is a martial melee weapon. It deals 1d8 of your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage with the attuned and solarian traits.

At first level, choose up to two of the following traits for your weapon. Alternatively, you can select the reach or two-hand 1d10 trait for your weapon instead of selecting two of the following traits.

  • Disarm
  • Free-Hand
  • Grapple
  • Nonlethal
  • Parry
  • Shove
  • Sweep
  • Trip
  • Versatile (B/P/S only)
  • Reach (counts as two traits)
  • Two-Hand 1d10 (counts as two traits)

You can select one of the following weapon groups for your weapon to be a part of.

  • Axe
  • Brawling
  • Club
  • Flail
  • Hammer
  • Knife
  • Pick
  • Polearm
  • Spear
  • Sword

Your solar weapon gains additional benefits based on your current attunement.

Graviton-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature using your solar weapon, that creature's space and all squares adjacent to it are difficult terrain for that creature until the end of its next turn.

Photon-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature with your solar weapon, you deal an additional amount of fire damage equal to half your level (rounded up). Your solar weapon casts bright light in a 5-foot radius (and dim light for the next 5 feet).

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.uvtdqSfKD6oXNA29]
items.description:
你对宇宙中的星辰之力的深刻理解能够通过具象的形式显现出来。你可以创造并维持所有三种不同的现象恒星显象：恒星耀斑，恒星光晕亦或是恒星武器。当你变为未调谐时，你的恒星显象会暂时消失。

恒星耀斑

一粒微小的恒星能量微粒悬浮在你身边，或沁入在你身体个部位，例如手或脸。这粒微粒能在短距离内释放定向能量冲击。你的恒星耀斑是一件搏击武器组的军用远程武器，具有调谐与恒星武士特征。它不占手，无需持握或持用。其他生物无法以你的恒星耀斑为目标，也无法将其从你身上移除，除了你变为未调谐状态。你的调谐状态决定你恒星耀斑的伤害类型与射程增量。你可将力量调整值加到你恒星耀斑的伤害掷骰上。你可以使用恒星武士水晶来提升恒星耀斑的伤害。

引力子调谐1d8钝击，射程增量15尺。重击时，你可以用自由动作尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]目标，忽略射程与多重攻击减值，即便你没有空手。

光量子调谐1d6火焰，射程增量30尺。重击时，目标额外受到1d6点持续火焰伤害。

恒星光晕

一层星辰能量环绕着你，复盖在你的躯体或穿戴的护甲之上。它呈现为一层散发的亮光或凝固的暗影，取决于你当前的调谐状态。光晕的整体外观与形态可由你自由选择，既可化作环绕周身的能量网格，亦可化作覆盖现有装备的带尖能量护甲。此类设计不影响其功能，亦不提供额外加成。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm]反应动作。

恒星武器

凭着纯粹的意志，你召唤出一把由星辰本源锻造的有形武器。此武器是你自身的延伸，可通过冥想改变其形态。当显化武器时，它会出现在你选择的空手中。如果该武器具有不占手特征，则可显化于任意手中。你的恒星武器是一件军用近战武器。它能根据你的选择造成1d8点钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，并具有调谐和恒星武士特征。

第一级时，为你的武器选择至多两项下列特征。或者，你可以为你的武器选择长触及或双手1d10特征替代选择两项下列特征。

  • 卸武
  • 不占手
  • 擒拿
  • 非致命
  • 格挡
  • 推撞
  • 横扫
  • 摔绊
  • 多用（仅限B/P/S）
  • 长触及（算作两项特征）
  • 双手1d10（算作两项特征）

你可以选择你的武器属于以下哪一个武器组。

  • 斧
  • 搏击
  • 棍棒
  • 连枷
  • 锤
  • 短刃
  • 镐
  • 长武
  • 矛
  • 剑

你的恒星武器根据你当前的调谐状态获得额外增益。

引力子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，该生物所处空间以及所有与它相邻的方格，对该生物变为困难地形，直至其下个回合结束。

光量子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，你额外造成等同于你等级一半的火焰伤害（向上取整）。你的恒星武器在5尺半径内散发出明亮光照（在此后5尺内散发昏暗光照）。

items.description:

items.name: 初等顿悟
items.expectedDescription:
You discover the basic truth of your connection. You learn your chosen connection's initial epiphany spell. Epiphany spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to spend time with your bonded allies or otherwise ponder the nature of your connection.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.
items.description:
你发现了你联结中最基本的真理。你获得了所选联结的初始顿悟法术。顿悟法术是一种聚能法术。施放聚能法术需要消耗1点聚能点，并且你在开始时拥有一个1点聚能点的聚能池。你在每日准备时重新填满你的聚能池，你可以通过花费10分钟使用再聚能行动来恢复1点聚能点，这包括与纽带中的盟友共度时光，或思考你联结的本质。

聚能法术会自动升阶到你等级的一半，向上取整，和戏法类似。聚能法术无需法术位，你也不能使用法术位来施放它们。获取专长能够赋予你聚能法术并增大你的聚能池，不过你的聚能池不能容纳超过3点聚能点。

items.name: 秘术师施法
items.expectedDescription:
You are a spellcaster and can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a mystic, when you cast spells, you might intone a prayer or hum a song inspired by your epiphanies, you might gesture or dance in patterns that follow the flow of your connection's network, and you might accompany your spellcasting with wisps of energy flowing between you and your bonded allies.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a mystic, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast, as shown on the Mystic Spells per Day table.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Since your key attribute is Wisdom, your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks. The signature spells class feature lets you heighten certain spells freely.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of mystic spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level mystic, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level mystic, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.
items.description:
你是一名施法者，并且可以使用施法行动进行施放法术。作为一名秘术师，当你施放法术时，你可能会吟唱祷词或哼唱受顿悟启发的歌谣，你可能会用手势或舞蹈来追随你联结网络的流变，又或许会在施法时让能量丝缕在你与纽带中的盟友间流淌。

每天，你可以施放至多三个1环法术。你必须知晓法术才能施放它们，你可以通过法术库职业特性来学习它们。你每天可以施放的法术数量称作你的法术位。

随着你秘术师等级的提高，你每日的法术数量也会随之增加，你可施放的最高法术环级同样随之提升，如秘术师每日法术表所示。

一些法术需要你尝试法术攻击来判断他们多有效，或让你的敌人掷骰对抗你的法术DC（通常是尝试豁免骰）。因为你的关键属性是感知，你的法术攻击调整和法术DC都使用你的感知调整值。

升阶法术

当你获得2环级以及更高环级的法术位时，你可以在这些法术位施放较低环级的法术的强化版本。这会增加这些法术的环级，升阶到所消耗法术位的环级。你必须在法术库中拥有法术的该环级版本才能将法术升阶至某一环级。许多法术在升阶至特定环级时有特定的效果提升。标志性法术职业能力可以让你自由升阶特定的法术。

戏法

你的部分法术为戏法。戏法是一类特殊的不使用法术位的法术。你可以随意施放戏法，每日任意次数。戏法总是会自动升阶到你的等级的一半并向上取整——这通常等于你拥有的秘术师最高环法术位环级。例如，作为一个1级秘术师，你施放的戏法为1环；作为5级秘术师时，你的戏法是3环法术。

items.name: 秘术纽带
items.expectedDescription:
You form a bond between yourself and others, most typically your closest companions. Forming bonds is different for every mystic but always involves using a 10-minute activity related to the mystic's connection that requires you to be adjacent to the creature with whom you wish to bond. You can maintain a bond with up to 10 other willing creatures, and the bond lasts until you or the bonded creature are no longer willing to be part of the bond. You are always considered part of your own bond and don't count toward the 10-creature limit.

You always know the general distance and direction toward other bonded creatures, their Hit Point totals, and if they're conscious, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, or dead. This ability doesn't work across planes (including when in transit in the Drift), and some special magical or technological effects might interfere with your ability to detect your allies.
items.description:
你在自己和他人之间建立纽带，通常是与你最亲密的伙伴。秘术师们建立纽带的具体方式各不相同，但都需要花费一个和秘术师的联结相关的10分钟行动。你可以与至多10个其他自愿的生物建立纽带，并且纽带一直持续到你或某个被建立纽带的生物不再自愿成为纽带的一部分。你自己总是被认为是你纽带中的一部分，并且不计入10个生物的上限。

items.name: 法术库
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

items.name: 适应天赋
items.expectedDescription:
You're quick thinking and adaptable, capable of picking up new skills and talents with little practice or training. During your daily preparations, select one skill feat that you meet the prerequisites for. You gain this skill feat until you prepare again. Since you have this feat temporarily, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option. You can use this for effects that temporarily give you access to other abilities, such as taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} to temporarily learn a new language.

As your envoy level increases, so does your ability to adapt to new situations. At 9th level and 15th level, increase the number of skill feats you gain this way by 1. You can use feats that you temporarily gain through adaptive talent as a prerequisite for other feats that you temporarily gain through adaptive talent, but you still can't use them as prerequisites for permanent character options.
items.description:
你思维敏捷，适应力强，不需要太多训练或培训就能掌握新的技能和能力。在每日准备中，选择一项你满足先决条件的技能专长。你获得该技能专长直到你再次每日准备。由于你是临时拥有此专长，你无法将其用作永久角色选项的先决条件。你可以将此技能专长用作临时给予你其他能力的效果，例如获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]来临时学习一门新语言。

随着使节等级提高，你适应新状况的能力也会提升。在9级和15级，分别增加1个你以此方式获得的技能专长数量。你可以使用通过适应天赋临时获得的专长来作为你通过适应天赋临时获得的其他专长的先决条件，但你仍然不能将它们用作永久角色选项的先决条件。

Your soul supports a network of energy that connects and heals those in your bond. Your vitality network has a maximum capacity equal to 6 + 4 Hit Points per level. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG] action that you can use to take Hit Points out of your network and into yourself or your allies as healing.

Life-and-death situations help strengthen your bonds with your allies. At the start of each turn in combat, when you regain actions, your vitality network regains 4 Hit Points; if you're master in spell DC, it regains 6 Hit Points instead; if you're legendary, it regains 8 Hit Points. When you Refocus, your vitality network regains all its Hit Points.

你的灵魂支持着一个连结并治愈你纽带中生物的能量网络。你的命能网络具有等同于6+每等级4点生命值的最大容量。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]动作，可以用来从你的网络中提取生命值并将其转移到自己或盟友身上进行治疗。

生死攸关的情况有助于加固你与盟友的纽带。在战斗中每回合开始，当你重新获得动作时，你的命能网络会恢复4点生命值；如果你的法术DC为大师熟练度，它改为恢复6点生命值；如果你达到传奇熟练度，它会恢复8点生命值。当你再聚能时，你的命能网络会恢复全部生命值。

items.name: 初等顿悟
items.expectedDescription:
You discover the basic truth of your connection. You learn your chosen connection's initial epiphany spell. Epiphany spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to spend time with your bonded allies or otherwise ponder the nature of your connection.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.
items.description:
你发现了你联结中最基本的真理。你获得了所选联结的初始顿悟法术。顿悟法术是一种聚能法术。施放聚能法术需要消耗1点聚能点，并且你在开始时拥有一个1点聚能点的聚能池。你在每日准备时重新填满你的聚能池，你可以通过花费10分钟使用再聚能行动来恢复1点聚能点，这包括与纽带中的盟友共度时光，或思考你联结的本质。

聚能法术会自动升阶到你等级的一半，向上取整，和戏法类似。聚能法术无需法术位，你也不能使用法术位来施放它们。获取专长能够赋予你聚能法术并增大你的聚能池，不过你的聚能池不能容纳超过3点聚能点。

items.name: 秘术纽带
items.expectedDescription:
You form a bond between yourself and others, most typically your closest companions. Forming bonds is different for every mystic but always involves using a 10-minute activity related to the mystic's connection that requires you to be adjacent to the creature with whom you wish to bond. You can maintain a bond with up to 10 other willing creatures, and the bond lasts until you or the bonded creature are no longer willing to be part of the bond. You are always considered part of your own bond and don't count toward the 10-creature limit.

You always know the general distance and direction toward other bonded creatures, their Hit Point totals, and if they're conscious, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, or dead. This ability doesn't work across planes (including when in transit in the Drift), and some special magical or technological effects might interfere with your ability to detect your allies.
items.description:
你在自己和他人之间建立纽带，通常是与你最亲密的伙伴。秘术师们建立纽带的具体方式各不相同，但都需要花费一个和秘术师的联结相关的10分钟行动。你可以与至多10个其他自愿的生物建立纽带，并且纽带一直持续到你或某个被建立纽带的生物不再自愿成为纽带的一部分。你自己总是被认为是你纽带中的一部分，并且不计入10个生物的上限。

你总是知道其他联结生物的大致距离和方向，他们的生命值总数，以及它们是清醒、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]还是死亡。这种能力在跨位面（包括漂流域中的通行）时不起作用，一些特殊的魔法或科技效果可能会干扰你侦测盟友的能力。

items.name: 秘术师施法
items.expectedDescription:
You are a spellcaster and can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a mystic, when you cast spells, you might intone a prayer or hum a song inspired by your epiphanies, you might gesture or dance in patterns that follow the flow of your connection's network, and you might accompany your spellcasting with wisps of energy flowing between you and your bonded allies.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a mystic, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast, as shown on the Mystic Spells per Day table.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Since your key attribute is Wisdom, your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks. The signature spells class feature lets you heighten certain spells freely.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of mystic spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level mystic, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level mystic, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.
items.description:
你是一名施法者，并且可以使用施法行动进行施放法术。作为一名秘术师，当你施放法术时，你可能会吟唱祷词或哼唱受顿悟启发的歌谣，你可能会用手势或舞蹈来追随你联结网络的流变，又或许会在施法时让能量丝缕在你与纽带中的盟友间流淌。

每天，你可以施放至多三个1环法术。你必须知晓法术才能施放它们，你可以通过法术库职业特性来学习它们。你每天可以施放的法术数量称作你的法术位。

随着你秘术师等级的提高，你每日的法术数量也会随之增加，你可施放的最高法术环级同样随之提升，如秘术师每日法术表所示。

一些法术需要你尝试法术攻击来判断他们多有效，或让你的敌人掷骰对抗你的法术DC（通常是尝试豁免骰）。因为你的关键属性是感知，你的法术攻击调整和法术DC都使用你的感知调整值。

升阶法术

当你获得2环级以及更高环级的法术位时，你可以在这些法术位施放较低环级的法术的强化版本。这会增加这些法术的环级，升阶到所消耗法术位的环级。你必须在法术库中拥有法术的该环级版本才能将法术升阶至某一环级。许多法术在升阶至特定环级时有特定的效果提升。标志性法术职业能力可以让你自由升阶特定的法术。

戏法

你的部分法术为戏法。戏法是一类特殊的不使用法术位的法术。你可以随意施放戏法，每日任意次数。戏法总是会自动升阶到你的等级的一半并向上取整——这通常等于你拥有的秘术师最高环法术位环级。例如，作为一个1级秘术师，你施放的戏法为1环；作为5级秘术师时，你的戏法是3环法术。

items.name: 法术库
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.
